text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"The accuracy decline observed after ~40 items in the append‑only baseline (e8af7ee8) is caused by exceeding the working‑set capacity, and inserting periodic consolidation/compression of accumulated context (as demonstrated in 085f93d4 and 45562236) will reduce cross‑fact interference and restore or improve accuracy beyond that point.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["e8af7ee8","085f93d4","45562236"],"tags":["capacity","consolidation","interference"]},{"statement":"Employing MemGPT’s virtual context‑management/paging mechanism (800e430c) as the pure‑append control in the rewrite‑vs‑append ablation (d421fc37) will isolate the effect of structured rewrite operations, allowing a clean test of reviewer 2’s concern (853b30eb) that gains may stem only from having any memory rather than the rewrite itself.","confidence":0.63,"support_ids":["d421fc37","800e430c","853b30eb"],"tags":["ablation","memory‑paging","rewrite"]}]}
